svg.text: The crawl loop: frontier → download → parse → dedupe → extract links → back to frontier

g.text: Seed URLs are placed in the URL frontier
Frontier hands out URLs, one host at a time (politeness)
Downloader fetches the page (after checking robots.txt)
Parser checks the HTML is valid
Duplicate content? (~30% of the web is duplicates)
New content is stored; links are extracted
Each link is checked: have we seen this URL before?
Only new URLs go back into the frontier — the loop repeats
